why_ai: A risk-bearing balance sheet, licensed adjusters and the appointed actuary's signed opinion protect the core, while desk claims handling, rating and policy servicing on screens are exposed.
why_clarity: Policies, rates and claims recur by the million under written rules, but in the liability lines whether a reserve or a price was right is known only years later.
why_digital: Claims start from physical damage and injuries but are worked as data on screens; many policies are still bought through local agents.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries must sign filings and negotiate with regulators, but indications and modelling are what ML already does.
why_clarity: Rate indications follow codified actuarial methods every cycle, and loss ratios confirm them within a year or two.
why_digital: Data in, rating plans and filings out, entirely on screens; regulators are dealt with remotely.

why_ai: Segmentation is machine learning itself; only rate-review accountability and consent rules keep people in the loop.
why_clarity: Lift and retention are measured objectively on huge, repeated quote and renewal volumes.
why_digital: Quotes, scores and rating engines are fully digital and sold remotely.

why_ai: Contested regulatory negotiation over modelled catastrophe loads needs accountable actuaries and judgement on rare, high-stakes events.
why_clarity: Methods are documented but disputed, and catastrophe outcomes that would prove a load right arrive rarely.
why_digital: Models, exposure data and filings are worked on screens; the regulatory exchange includes hearings.

why_ai: Licensed adjusters negotiate adversarially against plaintiff counsel on novel, high-stakes claims, and carriers carry the bad-faith liability.
why_clarity: Experienced adjusters read the same file differently, and the ultimate cost is known only years later.
why_digital: Claim files, letters and medical records are worked on screens; negotiation and defence are relationship-driven.

why_ai: Engineers walk plants and warehouses in person and judge hazards that imagery cannot see.
why_clarity: Survey standards exist, but engineers weigh hazards differently and the loss that proves a recommendation right is rare.
why_digital: Starts from physical sites visited in person; reports are delivered digitally to underwriters.

why_ai: Identification and packaging automate readily, while negotiation, arbitration and litigation keep accountable specialists involved.
why_clarity: Recoveries are measured in dollars against clear legal rules, and outcomes arrive within months.
why_digital: Claim files, reports and demands are digital, handled remotely with other insurers.

why_ai: Serving small mutuals depends on trusted consultants and association relationships, though the indications themselves automate.
why_clarity: Indications follow standard actuarial methods each year, but thin experience makes accuracy slow to confirm.
why_digital: Work is done on data and filings, but small mutuals buy through local relationships and associations.

why_ai: Verifying physical features of homes still needs some site evidence, but photo and imagery verification is routine computer vision.
why_clarity: Feature lists are defined by regulation and checked at volume against evidence.
why_digital: Starts from physical homes; verification increasingly from photos and imagery delivered digitally.

why_ai: Routing and straight-through handling of simple claims is exactly what models and conversational AI already do.
why_clarity: Routing outcomes and reassignments are observable within days across millions of claims.
why_digital: Claims reported by phone, app and web and routed in software.

why_ai: Mechanical mapping, edit-fixing and reconciliation are directly automatable.
why_clarity: Plans, edit checks and reconciliation targets give exact, instantly checkable deliverables every cycle.
why_digital: Data in, coded submissions out, through portals to remote agents and regulators.

why_ai: Modelling systemic cyber events is novel, adversarial and slow to validate, though the scoring pipeline is software.
why_clarity: Methods differ by vendor and only rare systemic events can show a model was right.
why_digital: Scan data and models delivered as software and reports to remote insurers.

why_ai: Rating committees, NRSRO oversight and reliance by lenders and agents keep accountable analysts central.
why_clarity: Methodologies are published but applied with judgement, and impairments that grade a rating are rare and slow.
why_digital: Financial submissions and meetings in, ratings and reports out digitally.

why_ai: Internal modelling is ML work itself; filing accountability keeps actuaries signing.
why_clarity: Lift, loss ratios and retention give measurable results each cycle.
why_digital: Entirely data and software, delivered inside the carrier.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries sign memoranda and handle regulator relationships, though exhibits and objection drafts automate.
why_clarity: Filings follow state rules and recur constantly, and approval or objection is known within months.
why_digital: Data and documents on screens, filed through SERFF for remote clients.

why_ai: Encoding public rating algorithms and running comparisons is mechanical work AI can absorb.
why_clarity: Encoded rates can be checked against filed algorithms and quotes across thousands of rate sets.
why_digital: Public filings in, data feeds and reports out to remote buyers.

why_ai: The appointed actuary signs the statutory opinion personally and carries the professional liability.
why_clarity: Reserving methods are codified and annual, but reserve adequacy is proven only years later.
why_digital: Claims data and models entirely on screens; engagements won through relationships.

why_ai: Anticipating emerging liabilities is novel judgement, but docket mining and literature screening are AI-native.
why_clarity: Methods vary and the mass torts a model anticipates take years to materialise.
why_digital: Dockets and literature in, scores and reports out as software.

why_ai: Driving scores are computed by models; consent and data rights, not people, protect the business.
why_clarity: Scores are validated against crash and claims outcomes across billions of trips.
why_digital: Sensor data in, scores out through software to remote carriers.

why_ai: As insurer of record the fronting carrier carries regulatory accountability for every programme it oversees.
why_clarity: Audit programmes and bordereaux checks are standard, but programme losses emerge slowly.
why_digital: Bordereaux and audit files worked on screens, with occasional MGA site audits.

why_ai: Statutory insurers of last resort carry public accountability, and demand grows as private carriers retreat.
why_clarity: Rate filings and depopulation follow rules, but catastrophe outcomes are slow and volatile.
why_digital: Policies and claims data worked on screens; policyholders reached through agents.

why_ai: Defending models to regulators is contested, accountable work, though test execution automates.
why_clarity: Testing methods are emerging and disputed, and regulators' acceptance is the slow feedback.
why_digital: Model and policy data in, reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Towing, storing and handling physical vehicles keeps hands-on work central.
why_clarity: Each vehicle follows the same intake-to-sale process, with sale prices known within weeks.
why_digital: Physical vehicles in yards, sold through fully online auctions.

why_ai: Full-scale physical testing of buildings needs labs and engineers on site.
why_clarity: Test protocols are documented, but the field losses they predict are rare and slow.
why_digital: Physical test specimens in, published research out digitally.

why_ai: Liability decisions on standard collision facts are routine enough for models, though arbitrators decide.
why_clarity: Decisions follow written rules and recur at very high volume.
why_digital: Filings and evidence submitted and decided online.

why_ai: Public accountability for approving models used in rates keeps expert reviewers central.
why_clarity: Standards exist but judging a model's science is contested and rarely tested by events.
why_digital: Model documentation reviewed on screens, with public meetings.

why_ai: Advocacy rests on relationships with legislators and regulators.
why_clarity: Policy influence is hard to define and measure.
why_digital: Research and advocacy are digital, but lobbying is in person.
